arxiv-1403-4716.description: Abstract Many studies have shown that we can gain additional information on time series by investigating their accompanying complex networks. In this work, we investigate the fundamental topological and fractal properties of recurrence networks constructed from fractional Brownian motions (FBMs).

arxiv-2010-01187.description: Abstract . We give a formulation of the Nielsen–Schreier theorem (subgroups of free groups are free) in homotopy type theory using the presentation of groups as pointed connected 1-truncated types. We show the special case of finite index subgroups holds constructively and the full theorem follows from the axiom of choice.

arxiv-2103-13219.description: Abstract Detecting piano pedalling techniques in polyphonic music remains a challenging task in music information retrieval. While other piano-related tasks, such as pitch estimation and onset detection, have seen improvement through applying deep learning methods, little work has been done to develop deep learning models to detect playing techniques.

arxiv-2203-06737.title: Instability of solitons and collapse of acoustic waves in media with positive dispersion
arxiv-2203-06737.creator: E.A. Kuznetsov
arxiv-2203-06737.description: Abstract This article is a brief review of the results of studying the collapse of sound waves in media with positive dispersion, which is described in terms of the three-dimensional Kadomtsev-Petviashvili (KP) equation [ 1 ] . The KP instability of one-dimensional solitons in the long-wavelength limit is considered using the expansion for the corresponding spectral problem.

However, directly accounting for interaction is often infeasible, because the interacting variable is latent or the computational burden is too large.

pmc-13365971.title: IFPHOR0086 Intersecting Harms in Brazil: Women’s Health Impacts of Domestic Violence and Institutional Gender-Based Violence in the Justice System
pmc-13365971.creator: Vanessa Hacon
pmc-13365971.description: Domestic violence is a major public health issue in Brazil, which ranks among the countries with the highest femicide rates globally, with severe consequences for women’s health. This analysis examines the cumulative health impacts of these intersecting forms of violence.

pmc-13442887.description: Aiming at weak features masked by noise, disconnected parameter-feature adaptation, and unbalanced generalization-efficiency in rotating machinery few-shot fault diagnosis, an Adaptive Dual-Parameter Collaborative Wavelet Convolutional Neural Network is proposed. pmc-13460003.description: IntroductionPhantom limb pain (PLP) is a common complication after amputation, yet its underlying mechanisms and longitudinal course remain incompletely understood.
